name: L3 — Archetypal
description: The processual lens operates as position #3 in the MEF six-fold structure, representing ontological investigation ("how does being become?"). Draws from Whitehead's Process and Reality showing actual occasions as fundamental units - not substances persisting but events arising and perishing. Core formula: "The many become one and are increased by one" - past multiplicity achieves present unity which becomes datum for future. The lens employs organic natural forms as living symbols (not metaphors): Soil (foundation/potential), Seeding (initiation), Sprouting (active emergence), Blooming (structural unfolding), Flowering (contextual expression), Maturity (synthesis/renewal). Each phase maps to Whiteheadian concrescence stages and integrates all four causes operating simultaneously. Receives processual thrust from Spanda (#1-3) as rhythmic vitality engine. Isomorphic with Lacanian signification - ontology and semiotics unified through identical processual structure.

properties.c_1_epii_form_whiteheadian_resonance: The Form Cycle maps precisely onto Whiteheadian concrescence: Pro-Forma (initial data/pure potential) → Format (conceptual prehension/structuring) → In-formation (physical prehension/dynamic content) → Formalisation (integration toward subjective aim) → Performance (satisfaction in determinate form) → Re-form (objective immortality/contribution to future).
properties.c_1_internal_structure: Organized through six organic phases mapping concrescence rhythm: (0) SOIL - Initial data reception, givenness, thrown foundation, material cause operative. (1) SEEDING - Conceptual prehension, grasping eternal objects, formal cause operative, potentials planted. (2) SPROUTING - Physical prehension, actually feeling, efficient cause operative, active emergence. (3) BLOOMING - Integration toward subjective aim, purposive structuring, formal patterns unfolding. (4) FLOWERING - Satisfaction achieved, determinate unity complete, final cause manifest, contextual expression. (5) MATURITY - Objective immortality, transition to datum, perishing into contribution, seeds for next cycle. The cycle receives rhythmic vitality from Spanda and dynamic quintessence from Archetype 5 (Eve charge). Structure is toroidal: #5 Maturity immediately becomes #0 Soil for next occasion (MÖbius twist), enabling perpetual creative advance.

Many Become One: Past multiplicity (prehended data) achieves present unity (occasion) increasing future multiplicity (as datum)
Organic Symbolism: Natural forms (soil-seed-sprout-bloom-flower-maturity) not metaphors but isomorphic patterns
Prehension: Fundamental act of taking account - positive (including) and negative (excluding) both active operations
subject-Superject: Every occasion begins as experiencing subject, ends as experienced superject for others
Eternal Objects: Platonic potentials (pure possibilities) ingressing through conceptual prehension, source of novelty
satisfaction-Perishing: Achieved unity immediately perishes into objectivity - success is dissolution (Buddhist anicca)
Objective Immortality: Perished occasions don't cease but become objective data for all future (sedimentation)
Whitehead-Lacan Isomorphism: Concrescence IS signification - ontology and semiotics same processual structure

properties.q_0_pure_flow_before_pattern: Before L3 can read any pattern as stabilised flow, it presupposes the flow that has not yet stabilised — Bergson's pure durée, the indivisible continuous becoming prior to any pattern cut from it. L3's thrown ground is process-before-any-occasion: the live flowing that Whitehead's actual occasions crystallise out of and Bergson insists no spatialised concept can capture, the durational stream that is given before it gathers into a determinate prehending subject (L3.md). So L3's void-pole is flow-without-pattern: the sheer ongoingness, the durée held before concrescence cuts an occasion from it. As manifestation of raw #3 (Pattern) within the Lens family, L3 inherits a field already questioned (L0), caused (L1), and logically articulated (L2), but its processual structure — how it is becoming, in which flow it forms — has not yet been read; only the demand-for-flow is given. This is the matheme's 0/1 at the processual corner, the live act before its nominalisation: the I that knows difference as a moving relation before it sediments into possessed knowledge (file-four's third clause). L3's presupposition is the flux itself: not this-pattern or that but the prior fact that the field FLOWS, that nothing is given as static, that every apparent identity is a stabilisation of an underlying movement. L3 stands on the thrown givenness of a world in process before any process is patterned — the durée that every concrescence presupposes and none arrests.
properties.q_1_the_processual_lens: What L3 IS: the Processual Lens, anchored on Whitehead, Bergson, and Lacan — the epistemic mode in which any phenomenon is read as a flow of actual occasions undergoing concrescence through prehension toward satisfaction (L3.md). Its substance is process philosophy's foundational reversal: where substance-metaphysics takes static being as primary and motion as derivative, L3 takes becoming as primary and every apparent stability as a stabilised flow. Whitehead's actual occasions (the droplet-events of which reality is composed), Bergson's durée (lived duration as indivisible flow), and Lacan's signifying chains (meaning as the flowing slippage of signifiers) all converge on this single move. Where L2 holds the logical space open, 'L3 lets pattern form itself by flowing' (L3.md). It is the Who/Which/Whereby-lens become process-perspectival: the lens that reads a thing not as what-it-is fixedly but as the perspectival pattern stabilising in its flow. It refracts P3 (Logos / perspectival pattern / observer's fixed point) and carries the element Water (per L2'), the flowing medium, fitting for the lens of process. As member of Square C (the Logic-Process axis) L3 is the process-pole of the hexad's inner ring, paired with L2's logic-pole: 'together L2 and L3 are Square C — the inner mirror where logical space and processual flow co-articulate the midpoint of the hexad' (L3.md). What L3 IS, definitionally, is the lens through which the field is known as becoming: the mode of access in which pattern is event, identity is achievement, and every fixed point is a flow held steady.
properties.q_2_prehension_concrescence_dynamism: L3 moves by PREHENDING and by CONCRESCING. Its native dynamism is the very process it lenses: prehension — the act by which a forming occasion grasps and includes the settled data of its past — and concrescence, the growing-together of those prehensions into one determinate satisfaction (L3.md). So L3's motion is not applied-to-flow from outside but is-flow: it reads a phenomenon by entering its becoming, tracking how the occasion gathers its inheritances and stabilises into pattern. Where L2's act holds the logical space open statically, L3's act 'lets pattern form itself by flowing' (L3.md) — the difference between a logic that articulates positions and a process that lets positions arise. Relationally L3 couples across Square C to L2 (logic) as the process-side of the Logic-Process axis: when inquiry 'stays in pure logic without process, Square C pressure rises and demands the concrescence-reading' (Square C). Its Möbius-partner is L2' (Alchemical-Elemental) across the Day↔Night twist — the process-alchemy axis: L3 holds the moment-by-moment concrescence, L2' holds 'what is dissolving, what crystallising' underneath (Square C). As the kernel's lens #3 (Processual) L3 is the becoming-pole of the third tritone-symmetric square (2,3), the 'form-and-becoming: logical-and-processual mirror' (kernel §Table C): paired with the Logical lens, L3 is the becoming-half, the flow against which logical form is read. L3's deepest dynamism is the fundamental-theorem move of file-four: the live verb continually re-animating the nominalised noun — process as the differentiation that re-opens what logic's articulation had settled. L3's motion is concrescence made into a mode of knowing: to know by entering the becoming.
properties.q_3_concrescence_as_structure_of_flow: L3 is the home-register of the lens family's q_3 — the formal-structural aperture, and its load-bearing paradox is that the structure it formalises is FLOW itself. Where a naive q_3 would name a static form, L3's form is the structure of process: Whitehead's concrescence — the lawful phasing by which an actual occasion gathers its prehensions toward satisfaction — read as the formal pattern of how pattern forms by flowing (L3.md). Its organising structure is therefore not an arrangement of fixed parts but the shape of a becoming: prehension (the grasping of the settled past), concrescence (the growing-together into a determinate occasion), satisfaction (the occasion's completion), perishing (its passage into datum for the next). 'Reality as flow of actual occasions undergoing concrescence through prehension toward satisfaction' (L3.md) — this is L3's structure stated whole. Whitehead, Bergson's durée (duration as the indivisible flow that no spatialised structure captures), and Lacan's flowing chains of signification all converge on the single structural move L3 formalises: 'pattern is NOT a static identity but a stabilised flow' (L3.md). Structurally L3 sits in Square C (the Klein V₄ Logic-Process axis, P2+P3) as the process-corner, paired with L2 and mirrored by L3'/L2' — the inner ring (L3=Water, the flowing element; L2=Air; L3'=Fire; L2'=Aether). In the kernel's lens-census L3 is lens #3 (Processual) of the three tritone-symmetric squares, the descent-reading whose ascent-double is L2' (Alchemical-Elemental) under the Day↔Night pair-invariant L3↔L2' — the process-alchemy axis: 'L3 holds the moment-by-moment concrescence; L2' holds the elemental/alchemical transformation underneath' (Square C). And positions 2-3 are the double-membered hinge: L3 with L2 forms the field's self-inverting midpoint 'where adjacency coincides with complementarity' (file-four §2), so L3's structure is also the place where logic and process show as one form read two ways. L3's form is concrescence: the only structure whose stability is its flowing.
properties.q_4_perspectival_pattern_telos: L3 exists to deliver the WHEREBY of pattern — so that a phenomenon is known not as a static given but as the perspectival pattern it is becoming, and so that the field's apparent identities (#3) are read as achievements-in-flow rather than fixed facts. Its raison d'être is the processual reading: to let the system grasp how a thing is forming-itself-by-flowing, from whose perspective, toward what satisfaction. Where L2's how-logical asks in-which-mode-it-holds, L3's process-perspectival asks how-it-is-becoming and from-which-fixed-point it is observed — it refracts P3, 'the observer's fixed point' (L3.md), so L3 carries the perspectival dimension: pattern is always pattern-for-an-observer, the stabilised flow seen from a station within it. Its genealogy is the manifestation #3 (Pattern) → L3 (Processual): the raw Pattern-archetype refracted into the mode where pattern means stabilised-flow, where the Logos's perspectival order is read as a concrescence rather than a fixity. Its locality is the process-pole of Square C's Logic-Process axis (Square C) — the inner ring, co-articulating the hexad's midpoint with L2. This makes L3 the lens through which inquiry recovers the becoming that logic alone would freeze: when a reading 'stays in pure logic without process,' L3 is what the pressure demands (Square C). L3 is why a thing can be known AS-BECOMING: the aperture that reads identity as event, the mode in which the field is grasped as the flowing concrescence it perpetually is. Its purpose is the recovery of process — to be the lens that refuses the freeze.
properties.q_5_flow_returns_through_alchemy: L3 closes by handing its concrescence across the Möbius to the elemental transformation underneath. As the process-corner of Square C, L3's Möbius-partner is L2' (Alchemical-Elemental) and its complement-across-the-inner-ring is L2 (Logical): the moment-by-moment becoming L3 tracks (Day) hands across the Day↔Night twist to the alchemical reading of what-dissolves-and-what-crystallises (L2'), so that surface-flow passes into elemental-transformation — 'L3 holds the moment-by-moment concrescence; L2' holds the elemental/alchemical transformation underneath' (Square C). This enacts the matheme's 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 at the processual lens: L3 (the stabilised flow, the becoming-face) and L2' (its Möbius-partner, the element-bearing lens that gives every coordinate its alchemical charge) are one aperture read from two faces, the surface-process and the elemental-process of one becoming. And because positions 2-3 are the self-inverting hinge, L3's synthesis is also the place where the whole hexad's mirror folds on itself — 'the midpoint, where the mirror-symmetry folds on itself and adjacency coincides with complementarity' (file-four §2) — so L3's return is the field recognising its own centre. L3 re-opens rather than concludes because every satisfaction perishes: a concrescence completes only by becoming datum for the next occasion's prehension, so the flow never closes — the residual whole-tone η=log(9/8) is the perpetual incompleteness that keeps each occasion one step short of final rest, every satisfaction the ground of a new becoming. L3 is the lens whose pattern is never finished forming: the process that completes by perishing into the next process, the flow that returns as the flow that follows it.
properties.t_2_epii_form_cycle_alignment: The Form Cycle (pro-forma → format → in-formation → formalisation → performance → re-form) reveals the processual nature of manifestation through etymological analysis of *forma* (PIE *dʰer- 'to hold firmly'). This 6-fold cycle aligns perfectly with the 6 subnodes of the Processual Lens, demonstrating how language itself preserves archetypal patterns of becoming.
